financial_years.quote: for the tax period July 2017 to March 2018(hereinafter, ‘impugned order’).

date.quote: impugned Show Cause Notice dated 27th September, 2023 (hereinafter, ‘impugned SCN’)

service_mode.quote: the impugned SCN and the subsequent reminder notice were both uploaded on the ‘Additional Notices Tab’ and the Petitioner had no knowledge of the same.

date.quote: impugned order dated 20th November, 2023 passed by the Sales Tax Officer Class II/AVATO, Ward 88, Zone-8, for the tax period July 2017 to March 2018(hereinafter, ‘impugned order’).

events.quote: in this matter, the impugned SCN was issued to the Petitioner on 27th September, 2023
followed by a reminder notice dated 10th November, 2023.
Pursuant thereto, the impugned order was passed on 20th November, 2023.

defects_argued.quote: Under such circumstances, considering the fact that the Petitioner did not get a proper opportunity to be heard and no reply to the impugned SCN has been filed by the Petitioner, the matter deserves to be remanded back to the concerned Adjudicating Authority.
However, it is made clear that the issue in respect of the validity of the impugned notifications is left open.

outcome.quote: Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside.
